versions.content: If an event is reported and an event memory entry with the same priority exists and the existing event is tested in this operation cycle (Test- NotCompletedThisOperationCycle bit == 0), the Dem shall discard the reported event.

If an event is reported and an event memory entry with the same priority exists and the existing event is tested in this operation cycle (Test- NotCompletedThisOperationCycle bit == 0), the Dem shall discard the reported event.

During displacement, if an event is reported and an event memory entry with the same priority exists and the existing event is tested in this operation cycle (TestNotCompletedThisOperationCycle bit == 0), the Dem shall not displace the existing event with the reported event.
